kinds.description: Compiled into the engine. Its config schema is derived by reflection from the Go struct the engine itself parses, so the schema is by construction the one enforced.

Contributed by an internally-authored package (see internal/noderegistry) — either a declarative node interpreted in-process or a dialed connector-sdk process, both served through one uniform contract. Publishes its own config schema.

nodes.summary: Builds a padded, prefixed reference code from a number — ORD-000042 — and its lowercase slug form.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Short uppercase prefix, e.g. ORD or INV.

width.title: Digits
width.description: Total digits after the prefix. Numbers longer than this are not truncated.

slug.description: e.g. ord-000042, safe for urls and filenames

nodes.summary: Post a message to a Slack channel using a stored bot token.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel id or name, e.g. C0123456789 or #general.

text.title: Message
text.description: The message body. Supports Slack mrkdwn.

thread_ts.title: Reply to thread
thread_ts.description: Optional. The ts of a parent message to reply under.

message_ts.description: Timestamp id of the posted message; pass it as thread_ts to reply.

slack_ok.description: Slack's own ok flag. Slack returns HTTP 200 even for application errors, so branch on this rather than on status_code.
